name: eSun Matte Olive Green 1.75mm
short_description: eSun Matte PLA can output prints with shine-free color and frosted texture. It comes on a vacuum packed 1kg roll
description:
eSUN Matte 3D Printer Filament vacuum sealed and box packed.
1kg/Roll 1.75mm diameter

The eSun Matte PLA can output prints with shine-free color and frosted texture. Low density, 1 roll of Matte PLA filament can print 21% more models. Smooth and flat printed surface, supporting structure is easy to peel off. Higher toughness, not easy to break.

  • 【Stable Dimensional Tolerance】Minimum tolerance and low warping to ensure consistent feeding and stable prints, good layer bonding, less stringing, no bubbles, easy handling, resulting in an outstanding surface finish and are highly precise.
  • 【Tangle Free & No Plugging】eSUN Matte PLA adopts neat winding technology, more beautiful appearance. Perfect roundness and tighter diameter tolerance, good winding, does not overlap or tangle. Melt well, feed smoothly and constantly without clogging the nozzle or extruder.
  • 【High Compatibility】Printing speed is faster than ABS, PC, PA and other material. eSUN Matte PLA provide a texture finish with the visual impact of reduced layer visibility, which make it perfect for creation needing low-key, rich and enigmatic appearance.
  • 【Environmental Friendly】Matte PLA is improved and upgraded based on Ordinary PLA, keep all the advantages of PLA, eco-friendly and non-toxic, low shrinkage, no deformation, no cracking. Scrap is reused to produce recyclable spool and packaging box.

Print Settings:
Best Printing Temperature:190-220°C
Bed Temperature:0-60°C
Printing Speed:30-90mm/s
Movement Speed :90-150mm/s

SPECIFICATIONS:
Net Weight: 1kg/Roll (Roll and label may have slight difference with the images)
